articles.title: From the Underground Railroad to the Youth Vote: 700 Kids Podcast What America Means to Them
articles.summary: NPR's 250th-anniversary student podcast contest drew over 700 entries. Winners explored immigrant dreams, the Underground Railroad, and a 16-year-old's voting rights. One grandpa said leaving Greece was 'very, very hard.' These kids redefine the American experience.

articles.title: 'No Reason to Shy Away': Germany's Merz Pushes Back on Trump's NATO Spending Criticism
articles.summary: Trump blasted Germany's defense spending as 'ridiculous,' but Chancellor Merz says Berlin will double its military budget in four years and hit NATO's 3.5% GDP target by 2029—six years early. The spat comes ahead of a tense NATO summit in Ankara.

articles.title: Fertilizer Crisis: How the Iran War Is Squeezing U.S. Farmers—and What It Means for Your Food
articles.summary: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has slashed global fertilizer shipments, driving up costs for U.S. farmers. Corn growers may cut back or switch to soybeans. But experts say the impact on grocery prices will be modest—farmers will bear the brunt.
